name: confidence-slider
title: Confidence Slider
description: A confidence meter that doesn't just relabel itself, it hands you a different amount of control: drag past 75% and one tap accepts the answer, drop below 40% and every generated claim needs its own confirm-or-flag before Accept will even enable, with the whole panel morphing shape live as you cross each threshold. An ambient glow breathes behind the thumb, the tier badge and claim icons pop in rather than snapping, and the Accept button gives a genuine spring-and-ring unlock pulse the instant it actually becomes pressable.
